title: Industrial Cybersecurity Technician
description: STUB. Hands-on technician who applies security controls on the plant floor: device configuration, backups, transient-asset and media controls, and first-line checks. NICE's DD-WRL-009 description names 'industrial cybersecurity technicians' as a role it interfaces with, but NICE does not define one.

citations.note: DD-WRL-009 description mentions industrial cybersecurity technicians.
